## v0.2.3 — 2026-11-03
- Reduce runaway repetition in local Qwen transcription with a mild repetition penalty and a generation budget based on audio duration.\ 为本地 Qwen 转写加入轻度重复惩罚，并按音频时长限制生成长度，减少异常复读。 - Report an error when Qwen exhausts its generation budget, preserve completed chunks and diagnostics, and let you retry from the unfinished chunk.\ Qwen 耗尽生成额度时明确报错，保留已完成分块与诊断信息，可从未完成的音频块继续重试。

## v0.2.2 — 2026-11-03
### English
- Blend the library and Settings title bars into their content in dark mode, matching the unified appearance in light mode. Keep native window controls and content spacing when switching appearance or reopening windows.
### 中文
- 修复资料库与设置窗在深色模式下顶部色带分割的问题，标题栏与正文融合，浅色外观保持一致。切换外观、关闭重开时保留原生窗口按钮和正文间距。

## v0.2.1 — 2026-11-03
### English
- Fix recording startup failing when microphone preparation is slow, including Bluetooth format changes. Audio enters the recording queues after both devices are prepared; preparation time is excluded from the recording start. - Keep the same receiving sequence when capture restarts after sleep, and re-enable replacement streams during device recovery. - Hide “Recover Recording” when the committed recovery timeline is empty. Keep the original recording failure visible if a recovery attempt fails, and preserve the recovery materials.
Runtime device switching, physical sleep/wake, and existing audio-quality and hardware acceptance gaps remain tracked separately. No change to transcription providers or credential storage.
### 中文
- 修复麦克风准备较慢时录音启动溢出的问题，涵盖蓝牙格式切换触发的等待。两路设备准备完成后再接收音频，准备耗时不再计入录音起点。 - 睡眠后重新启动采集沿用同一接收顺序，设备重建后的音源继续开启接收。 - 已提交恢复时间线为空时隐藏“恢复录音”；恢复失败时保留最初录音错误，恢复材料继续留存。
运行中设备切换、物理睡眠唤醒及既有音质和硬件验收缺口继续单独跟踪。转写服务与凭据存储保持原有行为。
